scope.purpose: Test one simple diagnostic-only LM/TR routing policy on replayed development starts, then enter generator-disjoint locked validation only if the declared development freeze gate passes.

tuning_domain.source: Frozen development-v0 outcomes only; no new local-solver outcome was executed while choosing the route.
selection_order: Reject a candidate if unsafe acceptance, actual budget overrun, or non-budget adapter exception is possible under replay.
Reject a candidate if residual-qualified non-Gold count or P_full_target regresses against NLS-TR at prefix 8, 16, or 32.
Minimize fully charged callback work, including routing diagnostics.
Prefer the larger minimum-dimension threshold when truth and work are otherwise no better.

replayed_candidate_table_prefix_32.rejection: same truth as selected route with more diagnostic and solver work

allowed_runtime_inputs: initial scaled finite-difference Jacobian numerical rank
initial scaled finite-difference Jacobian condition estimate
decision: If C1 is not declared, select NLS-TR without constructing a routing Jacobian.
If dimension is below 16, select NLS-TR without constructing a routing Jacobian.
Otherwise construct the initial scaled finite-difference Jacobian exactly as declared below.
If the Jacobian has full column numerical rank and kappa_2 is at least 20000, select NLS-LM; otherwise select NLS-TR.
A nonfinite residual, failed diagnostic callback, failed SVD, or nonfinite condition estimate selects NLS-TR and emits an explicit diagnostic-fallback record.

jacobian_diagnostic.backend: bounded central finite difference on scaled residuals in normalized variables
jacobian_diagnostic.boundary_rule: use both clamped sides when available; otherwise use the available one-sided difference; fail to NLS-TR if neither side is available
jacobian_diagnostic.condition: sigma_max/sigma_min only when numerical rank equals dimension

solver_configuration.endpoint_gate: unchanged independent residual, bounds, strict-guard, normalized Gold configuration 1e-6, and target 1e-6 checks

bootstrap.upper_95: mirrored one-sided 95 percent bound from the same saved plan

cost_accounting: solver residual callbacks including finite differences and fallbacks
fresh-process package/module load and cold probe

criteria: Unsafe accepted count, actual budget-overrun count, non-budget exception count, and silent diagnostic-fallback count are zero.
At prefixes 8, 16, and 32, ROUTE-LMTR-A1 P_full_target is not below NLS-TR and residual-qualified non-Gold count is not above NLS-TR.
At prefix 32, ROUTE-LMTR-A1 P_local_gold minus NLS-TR P_local_gold is at least 0.005.
The family-clustered one-sided lower-95 bound for prefix-32 P_local_gold difference is nonnegative and at least one family mean is positive.
At prefix 32, fully charged work is no more than 1.05 times NLS-TR work and warm wall is no more than 1.10 times NLS-TR warm wall.
Routing selects NLS-LM for more than zero and no more than 25 percent of starts.
Routing decisions, diagnostic values, starts, and checksums replay exactly.
Any family/problem/answer identity influences a routing decision.
Any endpoint bypasses the unchanged independent gate.
Any P_full_target loss or residual-qualified non-Gold increase appears at prefix 8, 16, or 32 versus NLS-TR.
Prefix-32 P_local_gold gain is below 0.005.
Fully charged work exceeds 1.05 times NLS-TR or warm wall exceeds 1.10 times NLS-TR.
An actual budget overrun, non-budget exception, or silent diagnostic fallback occurs.
A routing decision or checksum fails replay.

development_replay.on_freeze_failure: Write a negative development result and stop without materializing or accessing locked inputs.

criteria: All safety, replay, P_full_target, residual-qualified non-Gold, work, and routing-applicability criteria from the development freeze gate hold on locked data.
Locked prefix-32 P_local_gold gain versus NLS-TR is at least 0.005, its family-clustered lower-95 bound is nonnegative, and at least one family mean is positive.
No locked family loses more than 0.02 P_local_gold or P_full_target against NLS-TR.
False accepted, actual budget-overrun, and silent capability-fallback counts are zero.
Against LXR-LMQR, P_local_gold improves by at least 0.05 or fully charged oracle work drops by at least 0.20 at equal recall.
Near-rank and tangent families each improve by at least 0.10 recall or 0.20 work without multiroot P_full_target loss over 0.02.
No unrelated regular family loses over 0.02 P_local_gold or gains over 0.10 warm overhead.
Overall family-clustered lower-95 recall effect is positive and at least three unrelated family means are positive.
External cold cost breaks even within 32 selected starts.

locked_validation_recipe.decision_rule: A route may be frozen for future research only if route_freeze_gate passes. Production promotion additionally requires every unchanged original_promotion_gate criterion. Locked results cannot change thresholds or routing logic.
